sentences.text: CRIMINAL CASE No. 12370 of 2023

BETWEEN:-
 SONU PRAJAPATI S/O SHRI ASHOK PRAJAPATI, AGED  ABOUT 22 YEARS, OCCUPATION:

LABOUR VILLAGE  DHAMUR PARSURAM POST PIPRACHANDRABHAN  DISTRICT DEVARIYA U.P. (UTTAR PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI ABHAY TIWARI, ADVOCATE)

AND  1. THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH  POLICE STATION GRP ITARSI NARMADAPURAM  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 2. VICTIM A THROUGH POLICE STATION GRP  ITARSI, DISTRICT NARMADAPURAM (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI DINESH PRASAD PATEL, DY. GOVT. ADVOCATE)

This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER 1. This is the repeat (fifth) application filed by the applicant under Section 439 CrPC for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.85/2022, registered at Police Station-GRP Itarsi District-Narmadapuram (M.P.), for the offences punishable under Sections 376(A)(B) of IPC r/w Section 4, 5(M), 6 of POCSO Act.
Earlier bail application was considered on merits and dismissed.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.

There was dispute between passengers in railway train over reservation and Sonu Prajapati vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93146253/
1 sitting of applicant.

entities.text: Sonu Prajapati vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Due to said dispute, applicant has falsely been implicated in the case.
It is submitted that applicant is in custody since 18.02.2022, material witness in the case has already been examined.
Now there is no chance that applicant will be able to influence witness of the case and tamper with evidence.
It is further submitted that applicant is not having any criminal past.
He is a young man aged about 22 years.
In these circumstances, prayer is made to enlarge applicant on bail.

3. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the respondent/State opposed the prayer for grant of bail and submitted that prosecutrix is a girl aged about 6 years and applicant had violated her and he was found sitting on her berth in train.

Considering the age of prosecutrix and manner in which,
offence has been committed, application filed by applicant may be dismissed.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
5.
On going through medical report, it is opined by doctor that no injury or tear is found.
It is also improbable that applicant will violate the prosecutrix in and open train, where all other passengers are sitting.
Prosecutrix in the case has already been examined.
Since, material witness has been examined, there is no possibility that applicant will be able to influence the witness of the case.
Applicant is a young man of 22 years.
He is in custody since more than one year.
6 . Considering aforesaid circumstances, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on the dates to be fixed by the trial court.

8. The applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
C.C as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE nd Sonu Prajapati vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93146253/
